DESCRIPTION:
REMODELED HOUSE WITH YARD AND 2-CAR PARKING! PLUS, A DETACHED 365 SQ. FT. BACKYARD STUDIO / FLEX SPACE!
A rare bonus: a separate stand-alone building in the private backyard, providing approximately 365 sq. ft. of additional flexible space. Ideal for a home office, art studio, creative workspace, gym, workshop, or substantial storage.
•Yes, you get both the home and the detached studio!
•Living room and dining area with desirable, open floor plan
•Hardwood (laminated) flooring throughout the home
•Remodeled gas kitchen with granite countertops and all stainless appliances
•Three remodeled, tiled baths; one bath in the master suite
•Five bedrooms, with generous closet spaces
•In-unit washer and dryer
•Newer interior paint
•Newer exterior paint
•Refinished windows and blinds
•Cozy and sunny private fenced-in yard for you and your pet
•Two-car, side-by-side off-street parking
LOCATION:
This renovated, single-family home with 2-car parking is situated in one of the city's most charming and diverse neighborhoods: Excelsior/Mission Street. Mission Street provides a cornucopia of great coffeehouses, bars, restaurants, grocery stores, and shops, all within a few blocks from your new home. Short distance to SFSU and CCSF. A commuter's dream; the financial district is approximately fifteen minutes away. It is a three-minute drive to 280 or 101 freeways for a quick commute to the valley. The BART station is at Balboa Park Station, and public transportation is everywhere. Many private, tech bus routes pick up nearby.
LEASE TERMS:
The lease is for one year, but it is fully negotiable to suit your needs. To set up a private tour, please email us through this post.

This bright and spacious four-bedroom, two-bathroom home is available for rent in the desirable Mission Terrace neighborhood of San Francisco. Natural light fills the home throughout, and the primary bedroom features an extra-large closet for ample storage. Both bathrooms have been remodeled, including a deep soaking tub in one of the baths.
The kitchen is well equipped with a refrigerator, gas range, generous cabinet space, and Quartz countertops, making it a great space for cooking and entertaining. A sunroom at the back of the house adds bonus living space, and an in-unit washer and dryer make day-to-day living easy. One parking space is included in the driveway.
Ideally situated close to public transportation and BART, this home is convenient to restaurants, banks, produce stores, a private K-8 school, and the neighborhood library.
Key Features:
- 4 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom
- Mission Terrace neighborhood
- Abundant natural lighting
- Extra-large master bedroom closet
- Recently remodeled bathrooms, including a deep soaking tub
- Kitchen with refrigerator, gas range, ample cabinetry, and Quartz countertops
- Sun room
- Washer and dryer included (as-is condition)
- One parking space in driveway
- Convenient to public transportation, BART, restaurants, banks, produce stores, private K-8 school, and neighborhood library
- Tenants are responsible for all utilities - Kenny Realty will bill monthly
- No pets please
